name: Physics
description: Mechanics, Electromagnetism, Quantum phenomena, and the fundamental laws governing the universe.

chapters.title: Newton's Laws of Motion & Classical Dynamics
chapters.summary: Explores Galileo's principle of inertia, Newton's three foundational laws of motion, free body diagrams, friction, and multi-body gravitational mechanics.

chapters.title: Electric Fields, Potential & DC Circuits
chapters.summary: Coulomb's Law, electrostatic potential, electric flux, Gauss's law, capacitance, Ohm's law, and Kirchhoff's loop and junction rules.

chapters.title: Wave Optics & Quantum Dual Nature
chapters.summary: Huygens' wave theory, Young's double-slit interference, diffraction gratings, photoelectric effect, de Broglie wavelength, and wave-particle duality.

name: Computer Science
description: Core algorithms, hierarchical data structures, system architecture, and computational complexity.

chapters.title: Data Structures: Trees & Balanced Search Trees
chapters.summary: Binary trees, binary search trees (BST), balanced AVL trees, tree rotations, traversal orders (pre/in/post/level-order), and logarithmic search guarantees.

chapters.title: Algorithmic Paradigms: Dynamic Programming
chapters.summary: Optimal substructure, overlapping subproblems, memoization vs tabulation, knapsack problems, and recurrence state formulation.

chapters.title: Operating Systems: Concurrency & Synchronization
chapters.summary: Processes vs threads, race conditions, critical section problem, mutexes, semaphores, and Coffman's four conditions for deadlock.

name: Biology & Life Sciences
description: Cellular machinery, energy conversion pathways, genetics, and molecular biology.

chapters.title: Cellular Respiration & ATP Synthesis
chapters.summary: Glycolysis, the citric acid (Krebs) cycle, electron transport chain, chemiosmosis, proton gradients, and aerobic vs anaerobic fermentation.

chapters.title: Molecular Genetics & DNA Replication
chapters.summary: DNA double-helix structure, semi-conservative replication, leading and lagging strands, Okazaki fragments, DNA polymerases, and proofreading.

name: Mathematics
description: Calculus, continuous change, rates, vector spaces, and analytical problem solving.

chapters.title: Differential Calculus & Optimization
chapters.summary: Limits, definition of the derivative, product and quotient rules, chain rule, critical points, first and second derivative tests, and optimization.

chapters.title: Linear Algebra: Vector Spaces & Transformations
chapters.summary: Vector spaces, linear combinations, span, linear independence, basis, dimension, matrix transformations, determinants, eigenvalues and eigenvectors.
